findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_spf, check_dkim, analyze_email_headers, check_domain, get_domain_report · Private data: check_spf, check_dmarc, lookup_mx, lookup_dns, check_domain, list_watched_domains, watch_domain, get_domain_report, unwatch_domain · Public sink: check_spf, lookup_mx, analyze_email_headers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_spf, check_dkim, analyze_email_headers, check_domain, get_domain_report · Private data: check_spf, check_dmarc, lookup_mx, lookup_dns, check_domain, list_watched_domains, watch_domain, get_domain_report, unwatch_domain · Public sink: check_spf, lookup_mx, analyze_email_headers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
